capabilities: Track focused work sessions with a timeblock timer
Capture post-session effort receipts with ratings and a short note
Record daily check-ins on energy and readiness
Chart effort allocations, effort profile and burnout risk
Write a daily summary file for use in daily notes
extras: No local-only mode: sessions, receipts, check-ins and project details are sent to the Effort Mastery API, while note content is never read or uploaded. Extra insight phrasing, Discovery and expanded Warnings are PRO-only; burnout warnings are the same on every plan. An optional companion theme is available.
motivation: Built for the gap where a task list says you are doing fine while your actual capacity says otherwise, adding an effort layer to the workflow you already use.
problem: Task lists report what got done but not what the work cost, so a productive-looking day can hide declining capacity and burnout risk.

relations.evidence: If you use Templater and Periodic Notes, you can pull this data into your daily notes automatically.
If you use Templater and Periodic Notes, you can pull this data into your daily notes automatically.
EMRALD connects to the Effort Mastery API (api.effortmastery.com) to sync session data, metrics, and insights.

summary: Effort-tracking plugin that logs work sessions, effort receipts and daily check-ins, then charts flow, recovery and burnout risk.
